core_delta: Analyze multiple entities and dynamics through explicit event/entity graph structure instead of one case partition.
Revised active interoperability standard covers event logs and streams plus extension semantics.
OCEL 2.0 adds changing object attributes and qualified event-object/object-object relations across JSON, XML and SQLite carriers.
A community core model is separated from conventions/extensions and evaluated across independent implementations and cases.
OCEL 2.0 can be projected into a temporal EKG that preserves changing entity attributes through snapshots.
Declared state functions yield explicit state transitions and perspective-dependent state-aware events for diagnostics.
Formal assumptions make changing OCEL object relations manipulable without ambiguous interval meaning; evidence is still preprint-stage.
